subject: Andrews Middle School Virtual Tour
overview: Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent and Principal Mike Downs hosted a virtual orientation tour of Andrews Middle School for incoming students. The video showcased school facilities, academic classrooms, exploratory subjects, and athletic spaces.

items.title: Superintendent Welcome
items.summary: Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent welcomed incoming students and introduced the virtual orientation tour of Andrews Middle School.

items.title: Main Office, Gymnasium, and Cafeteria
items.summary: Principal Mike Downs guided viewers through the main entrance, gymnasium, and cafeteria, noting morning arrival procedures, free breakfast, physical education, and after-school clubs.

items.title: Technology Lab
items.summary: Principal Downs presented the technology lab and highlighted hands-on engineering projects such as model bridges and rockets.

items.title: Outdoor Athletic Facilities
items.summary: Principal Downs showed the outdoor athletic fields and courts used for physical education, recess, soccer, running, baseball, softball, and basketball.

items.title: Music Rooms and Library
items.summary: Principal Downs toured the music classrooms and library, outlining band and orchestra programs, music exploratory lessons, and student reading expectations.

items.title: Science, English, and Art Classrooms
items.summary: Principal Downs visited academic classrooms, highlighting the school's nine Chromebook carts, science lab equipment, and student artwork.

items.title: Computer Lab and Guidance Offices
items.summary: Principal Downs displayed the computer lab featuring updated hardware for computer science and coding, as well as student support offices.
